dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the maximum mid-body width toward a tapered posterior point.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Soft, diffuse gradient transition between specular highlight regions and the darker grey shaded lateral surfaces.
